paragraphs.text: Atalya was a legendary Human Cleric from Dominaria .

Atalya was a master of the Samite , a very large sect of devout healers, clerics, and alchemists on Dominaria. They are not a religious order, but rather concentrating on healing any sentient being in need regardless of race or creed. She was a light-skinned woman with brown hair who wore a white dress.
